notes.title: 7-21 - Performance improvements
notes.content:
We hope you're enjoying the game!

In this first patch, we wanted to address some of the issues with performance:

[list]
[*]Fixed some minor bugs when loading a map
[*]Enabled object pooling for: Projectiles, pickups and enemies, improving overall performance and stability
[/list]

notes.title: Popcorn time!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ClPdY97IEwc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Now you can watch the lore trailer when the game loads![/b]

We are working in a complete video player, so you can see the whole story between Gaylord and Zoe!


[h3]Other improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Adjusted some translations Spanish and English
[*] Now there is a floating message when you don't have enough DNA to purchase
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: New building!
notes.content:
[h2]Stir the trash[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010333/73ea0869249c6c87d149f01e4a0022ff5a7dc83c.png[/img]

This new building allows you to get [b]3 free items[/b]. Among the items, you can get:

[list]
[*] DNA
[*] Health
[*] A purple level chest
[*] A level 1 weapon
[/list]

Didn't get what you wanted? [b]Every time you return to the base you can reclaim 3 items for free![/b]

[h2]Childhood memories? Improved construction[/h2]

Now building is easier than ever! Just click on the area where you want to build and the building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010333/6bff43b3002e43c2fe2c8f01e31e04204153f358.png[/img]

A group of highly specialized cells will make your wish come true.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010333/333d591f825f7ae9699180383a3c9d8fd802d9ca.gif[/img]


[h2]And... How about a new song?[/h2]

Overdrive Infeciton, by Mr Dorian!

[previewyoutube=dYCHctbXxto;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Qué? Now you can play in Spanish!
notes.content:
[h3]Let's admit it, it was really weird to have an Argentina game only in English.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010333/5d92705f8511e0da4f86d28442e15b68adee2a51.png[/img]

Now, from the settings menu, you can choose between "Spanish" or "English." By default, the language will be English, but your selection will be saved for future sessions.

[h3]And the surprise is... [/h3]

A new song! For fans of [b]Bullet Hell[/b] composed by Guidosk, we have a new one: [b]Cell Siege[/b] by Mr. Dorian, to make your body thump while you wreak havoc!

[h3]Whats next?[/h3]

Soon, we’ll be ready to talk about a new map and other surprises!

[b]Add our game to your wishlist if you haven’t already and follow it to stay updated[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010333/f65552597ee3b7c0e964eddef2be4137dbcd36ac.gif[/img]
